newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends barely changed, activity reduced.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends barely changed, activity reduced.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended barely changed after moving within tight ranges on lack of support. Results of the Pakistan tender was not known. News of Egypt's buying did not aid the market which saw a lack of other fresh fundamentals
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also followed the futures and interest confined to nearby CPOs. Only selected products were traded.
Egypt bought 10,000 tonnes palm oil at $546.75 a tonne c and f for first half January arrival

Futures prices were moving within an eight-ringgit range, they said. The market will continue to hover at around overnight levels as players are not keen to participate because of the Thanksgiving Day holiday in the U.S.
At the close, February futures closed one ringgit down at 1,224 ringgit ($484.27) a tonne after moving in a tight eight-ringgit range.
Turnover on the futures market was 1,172 lots against 2,178 lots on Wednesday.

Among physical sector, Dec (south) was offered at 1,232.50 with trades reported at 1,230, 1,237.50 and 1,232.50. Dec (south) saw bids at 1,227.50. Dec (central) saw offers at 1,225 and bids at 1,212.50.
Jan (south) saw offers at 1,240 and bids at 1,235 with earlier trades at 1,240, 1,245 and 1,237.50.
Among refined products, Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $522.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/March at $520. Dec was traded at $522.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $562.50 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $552.50. Dec was traded at $562.50 and $562.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $377.50 and Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5275 ringgit)
